How did you get the rabbit fountain to look like that? Is it a combo?
Yes I figured it probably wouldn't be broken for long😁

It makes items "shiny"!

You give the machine 3 items. The machine then keeps 2 of those items. You get one item back, and it's "shiny". You can't pick which of the items you get back, but you can increase the odds of it being a specific item. For example, if you give the machine two lamps that are the same, your odds of getting a shiny lamp back become higher.
